+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+
+def load_projects(root: str, project: str | None = None) -> list[tuple[str, object]]:
+    """
+    Load projects from <root>/projects/* (directories only, sorted ascending by name).
+    - If root is not an existing directory, raise SystemExit(2).
+    - If project is given and <root>/projects/<project> is not a directory, 
+      print 'no such project: <project>' to stderr and raise SystemExit(2).
+    - Skip a project entirely when its .agent/task_board.json is missing.
+    - Return (name, parsed-board-dict) for readable boards and (name, exception) 
+      for unreadable ones (JSONDecodeError/OSError).
+    """
+    root_path = os.path.abspath(root) if root else ""
+    if not root or not os.path.isdir(root_path):
+        raise SystemExit(2)
+
+    projects_dir = os.path.join(root_path, "projects")
+
+    if project is not None:
+        proj_path = os.path.join(projects_dir, project)
+        if not os.path.isdir(proj_path):
+            sys.stderr.write(f"no such project: {project}\n")
+            raise SystemExit(2)
+
+    if not os.path.isdir(projects_dir):
+        return []
+
+    try:
+        entries = sorted(
+            [e.name for e in os.scandir(projects_dir) if e.is_dir()],
+            key=lambda s: s
+        )
+    except OSError:
+        return []
+
+    if project is not None:
+        if project in entries:
+            entries = [project]
+        else:
+            entries = []
+
+    results: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
+
+    for name in entries:
+        board_path = os.path.join(projects_dir, name, ".agent", "task_board.json")
+        if not os.path.isfile(board_path):
+            continue
+
+        try:
+            with open(board_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                data = json.load(f)
+            results.append((name, data))
+        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as e:
+            results.append((name, e))
+
+    return results
+
+def _normalize_text(text: str) -> str:
+    if not text:
+        return ""
+    # First replace every '\r\n' sequence with a single space,
+    # then replace every remaining '\n' and every remaining '\r' with a single space.
+    text = text.replace("\r\n", " ")
+    text = text.replace("\n", " ")
+    text = text.replace("\r", " ")
+    return text
+
+def format_task_row(task: dict) -> str:
+    """
+    Render one task as columns [id, TITLE, STATUS, ATTEMPTS, DEPS] joined by ' | ':
+    - id and title: first replace every '\r\n' sequence with a single space,
+      then replace every remaining '\n' and every remaining '\r' with a single space.
+    - STATUS is the task status verbatim when it is one of done|pending|failed else '?'
+    - ATTEMPTS is str(task['retry_count']) when the key exists, else '0'
+    - DEPS is ', '.join(dependencies) when dependencies is a non-empty list, else '-'
+    """
+    raw_id = str(task.get("id", ""))
+    task_id = _normalize_text(raw_id)
+
+    raw_title = str(task.get("title", ""))
+    task_title = _normalize_text(raw_title)
+
+    status = task.get("status")
+    if status not in ("done", "pending", "failed"):
+        status = "?"
+
+    retry_count = task.get("retry_count")
+    if retry_count is not None:
+        attempts = str(retry_count)
+    else:
+        attempts = "0"
+
+    deps = task.get("dependencies")
+    if isinstance(deps, list) and len(deps) > 0:
+        deps_str = ", ".join(str(d) for d in deps)
+    else:
+        deps_str = "-"
+
+    return f"{task_id} | {task_title} | {status} | {attempts} | {deps_str}"
+
+_DIAGNOSIS_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^DIAGNOSIS:\s+(?P<cause>.+?)\s+\(confidence=(?P<confidence>[^)]+)\)\s+remedy=(?P<remedy>.+)$"
+)
+
+def parse_diagnosis(feedback: str | None) -> dict | None:
+    """
+    Only feedback that starts with 'DIAGNOSIS:' AND matches 
+    'DIAGNOSIS: <cause> (confidence=<confidence>) remedy=<remedy>' 
+    returns {'cause': str, 'confidence': str, 'remedy': str};
+    anything else, including None and 'DIAGNOSIS:' text without the grammar, returns None.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(feedback, str) or not feedback.startswith("DIAGNOSIS:"):
+        return None
+    match = _DIAGNOSIS_RE.match(feedback)
+    if not match:
+        return None
+    return {
+        "cause": match.group("cause"),
+        "confidence": match.group("confidence"),
+        "remedy": match.group("remedy")
+    }
+
+def render_table(projects: list) -> str:
+    """
+    Consuming load_projects' output (list of (name, board-or-exception) tuples; a board is a dict):
+    - Skip (name, exception) tuples silently.
+    - For each readable board emit header '== <name> ==',
+    - one format_task_row line per task in board['tasks'] order (a board without a tasks list renders the header only),
+    - then one indented line '  DIAGNOSIS: <cause> (confidence=<confidence>) remedy=<remedy>' per task 
+      whose 'last_feedback' parses via parse_diagnosis.
+    - Join all lines with '\n' and no trailing newline; empty input returns ''.
+    """
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    for item in projects:
+        if not isinstance(item, tuple) or len(item) != 2:
+            continue
+        name, board = item
+        if isinstance(board, Exception):
+            continue
+        if not isinstance(board, dict):
+            continue
+
+        lines.append(f"== {name} ==")
+        tasks = board.get("tasks")
+        if isinstance(tasks, list):
+            for task in tasks:
+                if isinstance(task, dict):
+                    lines.append(format_task_row(task))
+                    feedback = task.get("last_feedback")
+                    diag = parse_diagnosis(feedback)
+                    if diag is not None:
+                        cause = diag["cause"]
+                        conf = diag["confidence"]
+                        remedy = diag["remedy"]
+                        lines.append(f"  DIAGNOSIS: {cause} (confidence={conf}) remedy={remedy}")
+
+    return "\n".join(lines)
